products.name: Braintrust
products.note: Evaluation-first LLM platform; datasets, scorers, CI quality gates, prompt iteration with production trace feedback

profile_text.body:
Braintrust is a San Francisco-based company founded in 2022 that describes itself as an active observability platform for AI agents. Its platform is designed to help teams trace production behavior, run evaluations, and catch regressions before they reach users. The company positions its tooling around the idea that AI systems drift and regress silently, and it surfaces patterns automatically to support continuous iteration against defined expectations.

The company's core product, also called Braintrust, is categorized as an AI governance and risk management platform. It combines datasets, scorers, CI quality gates, and prompt iteration informed by production trace feedback. A feature called Loop is described as generating improved prompts, scorers, and datasets automatically based on what a user wants to optimize. The platform also includes an MCP server that connects coding agents to a user's AI stack, allowing logs to be queried, evaluations run, and prompts updated directly from an IDE.

The held facts note 139 instances of legal exposure associated with California, though no specific cases are recorded. The company maintains a verified presence in the site's registry as of August 2026.
